title: Internet & Web Technology
description: Test your knowledge on domains, DNS, cybersecurity, IP addresses, and modern web networking.
seoTitle: Internet & Web Technology Quiz | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: How does the internet work? Test your knowledge of DNS, TCP/IP, HTTPS, cloud computing, and cybersecurity.

questions.question: What system translates human-friendly domain names like 'example.com' into numerical IP addresses?
questions.explanation: DNS (Domain Name System) functions as the address book of the internet, resolving hostname strings into IP addresses.

questions.question: What does the 'S' in 'HTTPS' stand for?
questions.explanation: HTTPS stands for HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure; it encrypts communications using Transport Layer Security (TLS/SSL).

questions.question: How many bits are in an IPv4 address?
questions.explanation: An IPv4 address consists of 32 bits divided into 4 eight-bit octets (e.g., 192.168.1.1).

questions.question: How many bits are in an IPv6 address?
questions.explanation: IPv6 addresses are 128 bits in length, providing approximately 3.4 x 10^38 unique addresses to overcome IPv4 exhaustion.

questions.question: Which protocol is primarily used for securely logging into and executing commands on remote servers?
questions.explanation: SSH (Secure Shell) provides strong cryptographic authentication and encrypted terminal access over an unsecured network.

questions.question: What is the standard port number used for encrypted HTTPS web traffic?
questions.explanation: Port 443 is the standard IANA port assigned for HTTPS traffic, whereas unencrypted HTTP uses port 80.

questions.question: Which web technology stores key-value data in the client's browser with no expiration date?
questions.explanation: window.localStorage allows web applications to persist key-value pairs in a client browser with no expiration.

questions.question: What type of attack involves overwhelming a server with fictitious traffic to make it unavailable?
questions.explanation: A Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack overwhelms targeted systems with traffic from distributed compromised machines.

questions.question: Which organization coordinates the global assignment of unique domain names and IP address blocks?
questions.explanation: ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers) coordinates the global maintenance of domain namespaces and IP allocation.

questions.question: What does 'CDN' stand for in web delivery architecture?
questions.explanation: A Content Delivery Network (CDN) is a geographically distributed group of servers that cache content close to end users for ultra-fast load times.
